content: In September 2026, Nintendo announced a new Switch 2 and controller set to commemorate the Zelda franchise's 40th anniversary and the release of The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake. While the game quickly became a massive hit, overshadowed only by the launch of GTA 6, the Switch 2 set unfortunately sold out in a matter of seconds. But there's good news: The Zelda 40th anniversary edition Switch 2 is coming back soon.
